body: Quick pass at a6ca6ffccd576c8faf4e6b4781a1e2ddf6282e40: the PR merges cleanly with main. The remote diff contains only the structural tests and decision record. All 10 quick-gate steps and strict UI clippy passed. All nine individual mutations failed their named tests. Production source is restored. The body names the tests and unrun lanes. No checks are reported; this is not green CI. Ready for independent review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: a6ca6ffccd576c8faf4e6b4781a1e2ddf6282e40 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings.

The tests meet issue #1533. Each new armed source has a separate lock test. Pausing or disarming that source restores the lock. The box test sends pointer drags in Edge and Face modes, with Command and Shift. It checks the selection, the open dialog, and the box state. It also checks that the same mode and modifier can arm a box on Geometry.

I read the full diff against the current rules in `upstream/main:AGENTS.md`. The change adds tests and a decision record only. It changes no production UI, geometry, stock simulation, collision checks, or G-code. Before/after screenshots do not apply. No fixtures, recorded programs, or goldens moved.

Local results

Worktree: `.claude/worktrees/review-4077`. Base: `034e91b8b78fa64989d18e1d5d17344531c4762c`.
The base is already the PR head's parent. `git merge --no-edit upstream/main` reported `Already up to date.` No trial merge commit was necessary.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed; 10 steps selected.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed; 10 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- UI library: 1,695 passed, 8 ignored. All 12 `egui_app::tests::pick_mode` tests passed.
- UI suites: `boundary` 3, `boundary_picks` 7, `contour_dxf_sketch` 2, `sinker_setup` 2, `tap_hand` 3, `theme_example` 3, `theme_files` 17, `waterjet_tool` 1. All passed. The gate ran the UI suites from `crates/ui`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: passed; 6 steps, 11 light tests, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- `git diff --check`: passed. The worktree is clean.

Extra suites run

The light lane ran motion `lib` (7 tests), `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and app `pocket_pass_start`. All passed. No fixture or importer change requires the extra STEP or feature-edge suites. No post or toolpath change requires the catalog suites. Full heavy lanes and pixel snapshot tests did not run.

Mutations

The PR body lists nine separate mutation failures and a restored green result. I did not repeat these mutations. This change adds tests only and does not require a safety-tier review. No source was changed during this review.

Requested before merge: none.

All builds and tests ran locally. No GitHub runner was used. The review worktree and its branch remain in place to retain the build cache.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
